title: Banister pistol-whips Jack Martin

tellings.quote: >> But Banister and Jack Martin got into a a fist fight over the assassination.

plain: In New Orleans in 1963, a man named Guy Banister and a man named Jack Martin got into a fist fight over the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, and the story's title has Banister pistol-whipping Martin. The author Peter Levenda, whom the episode calls a CIA historian, tells it to Jesse Michels without naming a source, as a sign that the two men knew something about the killing worth fighting over.
